en.headline: Man dies after collapsing at Sheung Shui foot massage parlour
en.dek: A 55-year-old man was found unconscious after a session at a San Hong Street shop late Friday and was certified dead at North District Hospital.
body: Police said a 55-year-old man surnamed Wong collapsed at a foot massage and beauty shop on San Hong Street in Sheung Shui at about 11pm on Friday. Staff found him unconscious on the floor of a room after hearing a noise and called for help.

Paramedics took him to North District Hospital, where he was later certified dead. Police said the cause of death would be determined by a post-mortem examination. Officers found no signs of a struggle or suspicious items at the scene.

It is understood the man had a medical history including a vascular tumour and conditions commonly known as the three highs, and attended regular check-ups at a public hospital. The case is being handled by the Sheung Shui district miscellaneous investigation team as a sudden death with no criminal element.

zh.headline: 上水男光顧足浴店後暈倒送院不治
zh.dek: 55歲黃姓男子周五深夜在新康街一間足浴店完成按摩後被發現昏迷，送往北區醫院後證實不治。
body: 警方表示，周五晚上約11時，一名55歲姓黃男子在上水新康街一間足浴美容店內暈倒。店職員聽到房內異響後開門查看，發現事主倒臥地上昏迷，隨即報警求助。
救護員將事主送往北區醫院搶救，其後證實不治。警方指死因有待驗屍後確定，現場未發現打鬥痕跡或可疑物品。
據了解，事主有血管瘤及「三高」病歷，並定期到公立醫院覆診。案件交由上水分區雜項調查隊跟進，暫時相信無刑事成份。
